passages.context: The complete dated English web homily was inspected. It is sustained exposition of Matthew 7 organized as numbered exhortative sections, treating judgment, prayer, conduct, false prophets, and discipleship. References to the devil occur inside moral and eschatological exhortation; the homily supplies no exorcistic rubric, ministerial reservation, case record, or operational procedure.

passages.context: The complete homily was read across Chrysostom's exposition of Matthew 14. He treats the disciples' disclosed insufficiency, Christ's blessing and multiplication, distribution through the disciples, gathered fragments, providence, and avoidance of waste. The witness supports direct ancient reception, not a reduction of the narrative to sacramental allegory.
